description: This file defines the EntityAccessControlHandler class, which provides default access control logic for entities in Drupal, including methods for checking access permissions, caching results, and handling field and create access.

classes.name: EntityAccessControlHandler
classes.description: Provides default access control logic for Drupal entities, including methods for access checks, caching, and field permissions.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a given entity and operation, utilizing cache and hooks.

methods.name: processAccessHookResults
methods.description: Combines multiple access hook results into a single AccessResult.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Default access check, can be overridden for custom logic.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached access result if available.

methods.name: createAccess
methods.description: Checks create access permissions for entities.

methods.name: checkCreateAccess
methods.description: Default create access check, can be overridden.

methods.name: prepareUser
methods.description: Ensures a user account object is available.

methods.name: fieldAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for entity fields.

methods.name: checkFieldAccess
methods.description: Default field access logic, including revision log visibility.

methods.name: buildCreateAccessCid
methods.description: Builds cache ID for create access checks.
